audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-fidelity female voice in a breakfast shop setting, speaking at a rapid pace to place an order. An upbeat, major-key pop BGM provides a rhythmic backing. (2) A male voice responds with a short 'Okay' and begins repeating some of her items, his pitch is neutral. The BGM remains constant in the background. (3) The female voice continues her list with high pitch variability and increasing speed, detailing specific condiments. A bright 'ding' sound effect emphasizes a particular request. (4) A brief pause occurs as the male voice proposes a change in procedure, asking her to write down the order. His tone is hesitant yet professional. (5) The female voice replies with a softened, apologetic tone. The BGM fades as the conversation reaches a temporary conclusion.
